What remains: the held "Record a payment received" button (Conflicts 1); references drawn as plain mono text because no row work_id is sent (Conflicts 16); "Unknown" drawn as the library's amber Unknown tag, not the board's bold amber words (Conflicts 16, component); the extra "Updated 12 Nov 10:00" line (Conflicts 15); the shell's bell, Overview/Setup links and persona name (Conflicts 14); and Chidi's avatar, which the tool cannot draw on the board (unmapped /_blob image).

D-83, Conflicts 17: measured 71.1 in round 1 and again in round 2 on a production build. SCR-20 is a list, so this needs the design engineer's board-level waiver; it is above the 70 floor. The phone draws every strip cell, the coverage sentence, all four cards (PAID included) and the note's full lines in one column (Conflicts 12). The board draws only "Owed to PSL" and three cards. The count line, the filter icon on its own row and the missing pinned "Record a payment received" bar (Conflicts 1) move everything below the toolbar.
